blocks.text: Akhlaqi research nataij ko qabil-e-bharosa banati aur shamil logon ke huqooq ka ehtaram karti hai. Akhlaqi hidayaat par chalna nuqsan, ghalat maloomat aur na-insafi se bachata aur nataij ko motabar aur doosron ke liye mufeed banata hai. Data ghadna ya credit ke baghair doosron ka kaam copy karna (plagiarism) ghair akhlaqi hai: is se ghalat nateeje nikalte aur researcher ki saakh kharab hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Motabar nataij ke liye research ethics ki ahmiyat aur ghair akhlaqi tareeqon ke research community aur muashre par asraat bataiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Ethics nataij ko qabil-e-bharosa banati hain: diyanatdar data, hawala shuda maakhaz aur munsifana, be-laag tajziya doosron ko nataij par bharosa aur un par mazeed kaam karne deta hai, aur raza aur raazdari shurakaa ko bachati hai. Ghadha hua data, plagiarism ya raza nazar-andaz karne jaise ghair akhlaqi tareeqe ghalat nateeje dete, doosre researchers ka waqt aur paisa zaya karte, science par bharosa kharab karte aur jab sehat, policy ya hifazat ke faisle in par hon to muashre ko nuqsan pohancha sakte hain; yeh researcher ki saakh bhi tabah karte hain.

items: Ethics research ko qabil-e-bharosa banati hai; dhoka aur plagiarism gumrah karte aur bharosa tabah karte hain.
